· MACD histogram trajectory (281.4059→211.2724) + Improvement diagnosis + Trend reversal signal: Improving but still in positive territory.

· Current range diagnosis (Accumulation/Distribution/Uptrend/Downtrend) + Entry/wait conditions: Accumulation phase, lack of directionality warrants a wait-and-see approach.
